title: Unlock Advanced Typography: Master CSS 'font-feature-settings' for Precision Web Fonts
tweet: Elevate your web typography! Master CSS 'font-feature-settings' to unlock advanced OpenType features like ligatures, stylistic sets & old-style figures for superior UI design & UX. #CSSTypography #WebFonts #UIDesign
tip: Elevate your web typography by directly controlling advanced OpenType features with CSS 'font-feature-settings'. This powerful property allows you to enable features like discretionary ligatures ("dlig"), stylistic sets ("ss01" to "ss20"), small caps ("smcp"), and various numeral styles (e.g., old-style figures "onum", tabular lining figures "tnum"). Judicious use of these features can dramatically improve text aesthetics, readability, and overall UI professionalism, especially in detailed content or branding. Always verify your chosen font supports the features and test across browsers for consistent user experience.
